topography.project_purpose: This brief describes the observed EVM deployment and audit surface for Ink Bridge. It intentionally limits the description to receipted repository and on-chain evidence instead of inferring a business model.
topography.relationship_narrative: The pinned logic-topography run contains 13 contract row(s) across ethereum, ink, sepolia. Structural roles: 11 supporting, 2 core. 9 row(s) use upgradeable patterns.
